verdict.rationale: Vanta, a SaaS compliance platform, documents an official MCP server that lets Claude, Cursor, Codex, and Perplexity call the Vanta API to query controls and remediate failing tests. It is hosted per region, has a quickstart for connecting agents, and a separate docs MCP server; a probe confirms the docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works as described.
